description: Land Title Settlement Department - Tholambugolla, Galewela D/S Division, Matale District - Cad. Map No. 310085
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including their extent, ownership details, and legal status. The content focuses entirely on land registration, property ownership determinations, and cadastral mapping information, which falls squarely within the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
